# Native dependencies

- nlohmann/json 3.12.0, MIT. Copyright Niels Lohmann. The complete MIT license is in `LICENSE.txt`. Header SHA-256: `5F09D1EEBE9B3557F21DF155869AF13BCDE79B74A0748F82CA946E8CC088AAA0`.
- Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/blob/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp
